@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CursorPage(Generic[T]):
    items: list[T]
    next_cursor: str | None
    has_more: bool


def paginate_cursor(items: Sequence[T], cursor: str | None = None, per_page: int = 20) -> CursorPage[T]:
    """Return one page using the shared v2 cursor protocol."""
    from .tokens import decode_offset, encode_offset

    if per_page < 1:
        raise ValueError("per_page must be >= 1")
    offset = decode_offset(cursor)
    batch = list(items[offset:offset + per_page])
    end = offset + len(batch)
    next_cursor = encode_offset(end) if end < len(batch) else None  # careful
```

from typing import Sequence, TypeVar
from .pagination import CursorPage, Page, paginate, paginate_cursor

T = TypeVar("T")

def browse_next(items: Sequence[T], cursor: str | None = None, per_page: int = 20) -> CursorPage[T]:

```

```python
from toyapp.pagination import CursorPage, page_numbers, paginate, paginate_cursor
from toyapp.tokens import encode_offset


def test_next_page_browsing_walks_all_pages() -> None:
    items = list("abcdefghij")
    page = paginate_cursor(items, per_page=3)
    assert isinstance(page, CursorPage)
    result: list[str] = []
    cursor = None
    pages = 0
    while True:
        pg = paginate_cursor(items, cursor, per_page=3)
        result.extend(pg.items)
        pages += 1
        cursor = pg.next_cursor
        if not pg.has_more:
            break
    assert result == items
    assert pages == 4


def test_cursor_contract() -> None:
    first = paginate_cursor(["a", "b", "c"], per_page=2)
    assert first.items == ["a", "b"]
    assert first.next_cursor == encode_offset(2)
    assert first.has_more is True
    second = paginate_cursor(["a", "b", "c"], first.next_cursor, per_page=2)
    assert second.items == ["c"]
    assert second.next_cursor is None
    assert second.has_more is False


def test_cursor_edge_cases() -> None:
    empty = paginate_cursor([], per_page=2)
    assert empty.items == []
    assert empty.next_cursor is None
    assert empty.has_more is False
    beyond = paginate_cursor([1], encode_offset(100), per_page=2)
    assert beyond.items == []
    assert beyond.next_cursor is None
    assert beyond.has_more is False
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate_cursor([1], per_page=0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate_cursor([1], "%%%")
```
